title: Water heaters utilized for space heating.
officialText:
Water heaters utilized both to supply potable hot water and provide hot water for
space-heating applications shall be listed and labeled for such applications by the manufacturer, and shall be built in accordance with
Section IV of the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code with an “H” code stamp. They shall be installed in accordance with the
manufacturer’s installation instructions, the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and the New York City Plumbing Code.
SECTION FGC 625
